summary:
Comprehensive Android Privacy, Permissions, and Google Play Policy Audit Report for Athar (com.athar.islamic):
1. Detailed Permission-by-Permission Classification & Code Usage Audit (Required, Conditionally Required, Policy Blockers, Removables).
2. Google Play Policy Blockers Analysis: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES (Device Abuse Policy), FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC (Android 14+ FGS Policy), and Prominent Location Disclosure.
3. Third-party SDK Data Collection & Telemetry Audit (Strict Opt-in Crashlytics, Google Analytics, Firebase Auth).
4. Google Play Data Safety Section Declarations Matrix (Data Collected, Purposes, Encryption in Transit, Retention & Deletion).
5. Account Deletion Compliance Verification (In-app deletion validated; Web-based deletion URL guidance).
6. Recommended Remediation Plan (Play build flavor, removing DATA_SYNC, prominent disclosure dialog) and Developer Manual Verification Checklist.
